run_cmd: run a shell command with a configurable timeout and proper signal handling
run_cmd_timeout: run a shell command that terminates automatically if it exceeds the specified timeout
run_cmd_sigint: run a shell command that handles Ctrl+C interrupts and cleans up child processes
run_cmd_killpg: run a shell command that kills the entire process group on timeout or interruption
run_cmd_setsid: run a shell command in a new session so all child processes can be terminated together
